protocol.ordering: Adjacent ABBA/BAAB fresh processes; identical iterations per pair

contract:
Broader aligned-grid screen across irregular reductions and larger matrices.

No dimensions are specialized. Aligned mode uses its guard-free entry only when
M and N are multiples of 16, otherwise the bounded 2D entry handles edge tiles.
Arithmetic, shared layout, K roots and barriers are unchanged. All output bits
and guards match the original GPU kernel. Above 32768 output cells the independent
CPU oracle checks deterministic dispersed cells and both corners, not every cell.
scope: Isolated kernel screen; full-model/runtime qualification still required.
